title: Marketplace transaction launch readiness
goal: Complete and certify the marketplace buyer, seller, order, payout, cancellation, refund, and webhook lifecycle

in: Listings, storefronts, carts, checkout, orders, seller onboarding, payouts, cancellation, refunds, webhooks, audit trails, and authorization
out: Advanced music rights and institutional commerce integrations

acceptance_criteria: The deployed staging listing-to-payout lifecycle passes in Stripe test mode
Buyer, seller, and tenant authorization denials pass at the server boundary
Money mutations and webhooks are idempotent, replay-safe, auditable, and produce safe error states
Deferred marketplace variants are gated and cannot bypass the canonical launch flow

Criterion assessment, local only. (1) deployed Stripe listing-to-payout: NOT MET, hosted/credential-blocked and additionally schema-blocked. (2) buyer/seller authorization denials: PARTIALLY MET locally and test-covered; tenant scope NOT MET and blocked on the persona schema. (3) idempotent, replay-safe, auditable, safe error states: PARTIALLY MET locally; replay safety is unproven against a real database and the final refunded state is webhook-dependent. (4) deferred variants gated: MET at code level, not certified deployed.

progress.summary: Wave 33: cleared the SEC-109 stale reviewed-debt entry that was failing the governance gate, hardened two money paths, and produced a criterion-by-criterion launch assessment. Guest order claim now refuses unsettled payments and refuses a claim that loses the buyer_user_id race instead of reporting success; seller refund now fails closed when its idempotency audit write matches no row. Checkout idempotency, buyer/seller authorization, webhook replay handling and variant gating are enforced and locally tested, but the deployed Stripe lifecycle and tenant-scope authorization remain unproven.
completed: Fail-closed checkout idempotency with payload conflict protection
Canonical per-account and per-variant launch gates
Refund, payout hold, cancellation, and seller authorization hardening

Removed the stale SEC-109 entry for app/marketplace/order/[token]/page.tsx and re-registered the debt that actually remains on app/marketplace/order/order-access.ts and app/api/marketplace/delivery/[orderItemId]/route.ts, so no marketplace path fails the service-role gate any more.

app/api/marketplace/order/[token]/claim/route.ts now requires payment_status paid or refunded before linking an order to an account or resolving its digital entitlements, closing a fail-open path where an unpaid guest order could be claimed.

app/api/marketplace/order/[token]/claim/route.ts verifies the guarded claim write with select/maybeSingle and returns 409 when a concurrent request won the race, so the losing caller is never told it claimed the order and never backfills entitlements under its own user id.

app/api/marketplace/orders/[id]/refund/route.ts verifies its lifecycle-audit write with select/maybeSingle and returns refund_audit_failed on an empty result, so a refund can no longer be reported as recorded when the idempotency ledger row was never written.

Established that marketplace_checkout_attempts and marketplace_external_listings are absent from the active migration chain and from lib/database.types.ts, which makes checkout fail closed with schema_not_ready on any environment built from that chain; routed to database as HF-DB-009.
next_steps: Land the additive schema reconciliation for marketplace_checkout_attempts (archive 20260728000011) and marketplace_external_listings (archive 20260728000003) before any checkout certification attempt; checkout currently cannot reach Stripe without the former.
Accept HF-DB-009-MARKETPLACE-TYPE-AND-RPC-SURFACE in the database lane to regenerate lib/database.types.ts and add a single-statement buyer-scoped marketplace_entitlements download-increment RPC.

Run the deployed Stripe test-mode listing-to-payout lifecycle and replay certification on one isolated staging deployment at an exact SHA, with campaign actors, once the schema reconciliation has landed and HF-DB-009 is accepted.

Decide whether to add tenant (organization/venue) scope to the marketplace order lifecycle; marketplace is seller_user_id-scoped only, so the tenant-authorization half of this criterion cannot be met while seller_entity_id/seller_entity_type stay archive-only.
blockers: No staging deployment, Stripe test-mode credentials, or hosted webhook evidence is available to this lane, so the deployed listing-to-payout lifecycle criterion cannot be certified here. No payment-provider or hosted result is claimed.

marketplace_checkout_attempts is local_only_unapplied (archive MANIFEST.csv:257) and absent from the active chain, so the checkout idempotency ledger does not exist on any environment built from supabase/migrations/; the route fails closed with 503 schema_not_ready. The 23505 unique-violation race handling at app/api/marketplace/checkout/route.ts:408 is therefore untested against a real constraint.

marketplace_external_listings is local_only_unapplied (archive MANIFEST.csv:249) and absent from the active chain and from lib/database.types.ts, so the external-listing import and dead-CTA redirect paths cannot be certified. Routed to database as HF-DB-009.

npm run check:service-role-allowlist exits 1 solely on app/api/venue/availability/route.ts:4 and app/api/venue/reservations/route.ts:3, two untracked files created by a concurrent venue lane and not in HEAD. No marketplace path fails the gate. Routed to venue as HF-VENUE-SERVICE-ROLE-IMPORTS.

Tenant (organization/venue) authorization denials are not implemented: the marketplace order lifecycle is scoped by seller_user_id only, and the canonical seller_entity_id/seller_entity_type persona columns remain archive-only under MKT-002.
Full repository npm run typecheck was not run: the control plane measured it at 68m18s with 1,384 errors across 407 files. No typecheck result is claimed from this lane.
